author: SickProdigy
description: Connect Discord to an AzerothCore World of Warcraft (WoW) server with player information, account self-service, ac-api-v1, and optional SOAP tools.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores per-guild backend settings, Discord-to-AzerothCore account links, and password-reset timestamps. User deletion removes their links and reset metadata. Private API and SOAP credentials remain in guild-scoped Red shared API tokens and are never included in Discord output.
install_msg: Run [p]wowset backend for guild-scoped setup. The Red bot owner configures SOAP and optional ac-api-v1 credentials, enables the guild profile, and separately trusts account management before use.
name: AzerothCore
short: AzerothCore World of Warcraft (WoW) server tools
